text: Following the earlier episode of scripted outreach on 11/20, the same individual exhibited a reactive exposure response when confronted with an environment that deviated from their expected pattern. Upon discovering that a close peer's stated plans ("busy with work") did not match observable behavior in a social setting, the individual reacted with abrupt frustration ("fuck you"), followed by immediate narrative-patching ("I don't care," "I knew you'd be on"). Expectation of compliance was violated, producing instability. A compensatory outburst was used to restore internal control and reassert predictive authority while masking earlier emotional leakage. The individual showed visible difficulty integrating the mismatch between stated intentions and observed reality, and continued a pattern of joining and leaving social environments upon detecting unpredictability. This event represents a progression of the earlier 11/20 behavioral pattern—shifting from continuity-performance into continuity breakdown, with low tolerance for variance driving reactive behavior aimed at stabilizing self-consistency rather than engaging the actual situation.

meta.note: Progression of 11/20 narrative-maintenance pattern: from scripted continuity-performance to overt continuity failure when predictive script is violated. Local micro-field example of authority-split between internal narrative and external reality.
